scenario: Open Alotau, Wewak and Buka stores
baseline: Baseline — network as it operates today

steps.title: Establish distribution hub at Alotau Area Medical Store (proposed)
steps.detail: Stand up Alotau Area Medical Store (proposed) as an operating hub serving 5 facilities and 361 m³ per year. Requires storage fit-out, cold chain commissioning, staffing and an inbound primary route.
steps.evidence: Scenario 'Open Alotau, Wewak and Buka stores' assigns 361 m³/yr to this hub.
steps.risk: Capital approval and site availability are the critical path.

steps.title: Reassign 21 facilities to a different supplying hub
steps.detail: Update the distribution plan, requisition routing in the eLMIS, and transport contracts. Facilities affected: PNG-ESP-001 (AMS-MAD→AMS-WWK), PNG-ESP-002 (AMS-MAD→AMS-WWK), PNG-ESP-003 (AMS-MAD→AMS-WWK), PNG-ESP-004 (AMS-MAD→AMS-WWK), PNG-ESP-005 (AMS-MAD→AMS-WWK), PNG-ESP-006 (AMS-MAD→AMS-WWK) and 15 more
steps.risk: Requires mSupply configuration change and re-training at each facility.
